title: CreatePipelineTransactionalStepRequest
description: One step of the single-call POST /api/pipelines request (HEL-906 task 3.1). `clientId` is request-scoped only, never persisted -- it lets a later step's `parentStepId` target an earlier step in the same request. `parentStepId` absent extends the trunk; present must resolve to an earlier step's `clientId` in this same request.
